title: List all the names of events that had an attendance of over 20 students but
question:
List all the names of events that had an attendance of over 20 students but were not fundraisers.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: name of events refers to event_name; attendance of over 20 students COUNT(event_id) > 20.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.XCL_011
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001
WHERE e.XCL_013 != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.XCL_010
HAVING COUNT(a.XCL_002) > 20
